caption:
Can someone explain this? 😅

You don't buy anything fancy. Just milk, eggs, bread, and somehow the receipt looks like a car payment.

And your paycheck still says the same number.

What's one item that shocked you at the register this month?
first_comment: What's the one grocery item you've stopped buying because of the price? 👇
